This led to repetitive and inconclusive searches, which should have been resolved earlier.

So, the Planner made the mistake by not effectively synthesizing the information and instead repeatedly issuing instructions without achieving a definitive conclusion. This mistake occurred at step 3, where the Planner should have consolidated the findings but instead continued the cycle of searches.
